description: This Dart source file defines a RealtimeService class that manages WebSocket and Server-Sent Events (SSE) connections for real-time communication, including connection handling, automatic reconnection with exponential backoff, topic subscription management, and message parsing.

classes.name: _Backoff
classes.description: Internal helper class for managing exponential backoff with jitter during reconnection attempts.

classes.name: RealtimeService
classes.description: Main service class providing WebSocket connectivity with fallback to SSE, topic management, auto-reconnect, and message streaming.

methods.name: withTokenGetter
methods.description: Convenience static method to create a RealtimeService instance with a custom token getter.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiates connection to the real-time server, attempting WebSocket first, then falling back to SSE.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to a specific topic, sending relevant command over WebSocket or triggering reconnection for SSE.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes from a specified topic, updating server subscription via WebSocket or reconnecting for SSE.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes current connection and stops reconnection attempts.
